comments: Challenges conventional assumption that longwave radiation is negligible in blackbody clouds, but implications for climate models require broader validation.

model_io.model: radiative transfer calculations and high-resolution cloud simulations

hypotheses.hypothesis: Longwave radiation effects are negligible in blackbody clouds
hypotheses.result: Disproven: cooling modulation alters dynamics and entrainment significantly

title: Clarifying intralayer and interlayer electron-phonon interaction of bilayer graphene with isotope-labelled Raman spectroscopy
task: Clarify intra- and interlayer electron-phonon interaction in bilayer graphene via isotope labeling
key_results: G, R, R' peaks originate from intralayer el-ph interaction; 2G, G+R', 2R' peaks near 3170 cm⁻¹ from interlayer el-ph interaction; resonance mechanisms identified
comments: Isotope-labeling Raman spectroscopy provides clear separation of coupling mechanisms, though twist-angle dependence suggests further work needed on moiré effects.

model_io.model: bilayer graphene with isotope-labeled atoms and Raman spectroscopy

hypotheses.hypothesis: G, R, R' peaks reflect intralayer and 2G, G+R', 2R' peaks reflect interlayer el-ph interaction
hypotheses.result: Confirmed with isotope labeling; resonance conditions identified for each peak type

title: Conical-angle-modulated continuous optical bottles beam for annular micromanipulation
task: Generate tunable continuous optical bottles beams for annular micromanipulation via conical-angle modulation
key_results: Conical-angle-modulated continuous optical bottles beam (COBB) from Airyprime vortex superposition; annular trap radius tunable 1.10–2.02 µm by rotating speed 1.32–3.71 rad s⁻¹ at fixed charge
comments: Demonstrates scalable control over optical bottle geometry for orbital micromanipulation, though throughput and robustness in viscous media need further study.

model_io.model: Continuous optical bottles beam (COBB) from superposed circular Airyprime vortex beams

hypotheses.hypothesis: Conical-angle modulation controls COBB structure and orbital trapping capability
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: annular trap radius tunable 1.10–2.02 µm via rotation speed modulation

title: Sequential transcriptional waves and NF-κB-driven chromatin remodeling direct drug-induced dedifferentiation in cancer
task: Elucidate epigenomic and transcriptomic programs driving drug-induced dedifferentiation in melanoma
key_results: Two sequential transcriptional waves driven by NF-κB/RelA chromatin remodeling orchestrate hysteretic cell-state transitions; oxidative stress-mediated NF-κB activation identified as common driver of drug-tolerant persister states across cancer models
comments: Sophisticated multi-omics integration with information-theoretic modeling strengthens mechanistic claims, though functional validation of the epigenetic gauge across diverse contexts remains to be demonstrated.
